entries.headline: Shohei Ohtani connected at +477
entries.story: Shohei Ohtani cashed. Facing Shane Drohan, he went deep in the 2nd in his 2nd at bat. The call: "Shohei Ohtani homers (1) on a fly ball to right center field. Teoscar Hernández scores. Andy Pages scores." Final line: 1-for-4.

entries.headline: Jake Bauers came close
entries.story: Jake Bauers went 1-for-3 with 1 BB and 3 RBI against Tyler Glasnow and the Los Angeles Dodgers. Closest call was a double in the 4th: "Jake Bauers hits a ground-rule double (1) on a line drive to right field. Brice Turang scores. William Contreras scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.
